ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Suspicious Mofcomp Execution
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects execution of the "mofcomp" utility as a child of a suspicious shell or script running utility or by having a suspicious path in the commandline.
The "mofcomp" utility parses a file containing MOF statements and adds the classes and class instances defined in the file to the WMI repository.
Attackers abuse this utility to install malicious MOF scripts

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\mofcomp\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "mofcomp\.exe") AND ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wsl\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\WINDOWS\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%temp\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%tmp\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%appdata\\%.*")))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\wbem\\WmiPrvSE\.exe" AND process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\TEMP\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX("\\\.mof$"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\TEMP\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX("\\\.mof$")))
